11S.C.R.614 SATISH KUMAR v. KARAN SINGH AND ANOTHER (Civil Appeal No. 7385 of2013) JANUARY 21, 2016 (M.Y. EQBAL AND ARUN MlSHRA, JJ.) Specific Relief Act, 1963 - s.20 - Specific performance of contract - Requirement of law for passing decree for specific C performance - Lease-hold plot respondent - Balance amount was to be paid by respondent subsequently - Responde11t filed suit for specific performance - Trial court held that the said D receipt-cum-agreement was an enforceable contract and on that finding decreed the suit which was affirmed by the High Court - Held: Specific
